title: The Death of Two Great Minds
author: Alex Watson
tags: The Hitch-hiker's Guide to the Galaxy
description: In this small tribute game to Douglas Adams, you play as Arthur Dent. Together with Fenchurch and Ford, you have travelled to the planet Preliumtarn to read God's Final Message To His Creation, which is said to be written in thirty-foot high letters of fire on top of the Quentulus Quazgar Mountains.
